scenario.title: Sam and Priya: active couple, big suburban house and backyard
scenario.room: Spacious living room with lots of clear floor, a dog-bed-sized corner, wide glass doors to a fenced grassy backyard

suggestions.name: Labrador Retriever
suggestions.reason: Their eager to please nature and adaptable energy thrive with active owners in spacious homes.
suggestions.watch_out: Plan for regular brushing to manage heavy shedding throughout the year.

suggestions.name: Bracco Italiano
suggestions.reason: Highly trainable and gentle, this active breed matches your outdoor daily exercise routine perfectly.
suggestions.watch_out: Ensure you provide mental stimulation alongside your daily physical workouts.

suggestions.name: Boxer
suggestions.reason: Playful and energetic, they love active households with plenty of yard space to run.
suggestions.watch_out: Consistent positive training is essential to manage their bouncy enthusiasm.

suggestions.name: Bernese Mountain Dog
suggestions.reason: Friendly and eager to please, they fit wonderfully into an active home with garden access.
suggestions.watch_out: Prepare for significant coat care and heavy shedding in warmer months.

suggestions.name: Bergamasco Sheepdog
suggestions.reason: Calm and loyal, their moderate energy matches well with daily exercise and large yards.
suggestions.watch_out: Their unique coat requires specific grooming techniques to maintain healthy mats.

suggestions.name: American Bulldog
suggestions.reason: Confident and trainable, they appreciate having a spacious yard and active daily exercise.
suggestions.watch_out: Early socialization helps build confident interactions with other dogs outside.

suggestions.name: Belgian Malinois
suggestions.reason: Highly trainable and driven, they will happily join your long daily workouts and activities.
suggestions.watch_out: Plan for intense daily mental exercise to keep their sharp mind focused.

suggestions.name: Airedale Terrier
suggestions.reason: Athletic and outgoing, this versatile breed enjoys active outdoor routines in a large home.
suggestions.watch_out: Keep training engaging to keep their independent terrier spirit focused.

room_check.line: Your space suits a Labrador Retriever well. A few small extras are below if you'd like them.
room_check.summary: A spacious, sunlit living room with hardwood floors and a large area rug opening directly via bifold doors onto a fenced lawn and deck. A comfortable dog bed is already set up in the corner of the room.
what_to_change: Elevate floor-level houseplants onto higher tables or shelves.
Add a non-slip runner rug along the bare wood walkway to the garden.
Ensure outdoor boundary gates are securely closed when leaving bifold doors open.
